title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Desenvolvimento ServiceNow Sênior
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com ServiceNow.



Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas utilizando ServiceNow App Engine
  • Criação e customização de portais (front-end) no ServiceNow
  • Desenvolvimento com tecnologias modernas como:
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Angular / React
  • Definição e evolução da arquitetura de soluções, garantindo escalabilidade e performance
  • Atuação próxima com áreas de negócio para levantamento e entendimento de requisitos
  • Garantia de boas práticas (segurança, performance e usabilidade)
  • Implementação de integrações entre sistemas, utilizando:
  • APIs REST
  • SOAP
  • Recursos nativos do ServiceNow


Requisitos Técnicos


  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos com ServiceNow
  • Forte atuação com:
  • ServiceNow App Engine
  • Service Portal
  • Widgets
  • APIs REST
  • Integrações com sistemas externos
  • Sólida experiência em:
  • Arquitetura de soluções
  • Sistemas escaláveis e de alta performance
  • Experiência em front-end:
  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Frameworks como Angular ou React


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VempraGFT

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

title: German Data Annotator
description:
We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .


Role Details

  • Work Mode: Remote
  • Engagement Type: Contract 1-3 Months
  • Daily Commitment: 5–6 hours
  • Pay Rate: $5 per hour


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: High School Graduate (or higher) .
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


Next Steps: Evaluation Process

To proceed with your application, please complete the following assessments:

1️⃣ Assessment Test

Assesses your linguistic and analytical skills.


LLM Evaluation Test:


Please note that keeping your camera & location on is mandatory during the assessment. Submissions without camera & location compliance may not be considered.


2️⃣ Versant English Proficiency Test

Evaluates your spoken and written English proficiency.

A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify.


✅ Once both assessments are successfully completed, you’ll be eligible for onboarding and background verification .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.

title: Operations Director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director


Introduction:

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.


This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.


Compensation:

  • $40,000-90,000 USD per year.


Duties & Responsibilities:


Permitting

  • Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
  • Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
  • Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
  • Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
  • Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.


Development Support

  • Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
  • File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.


Procurement

  • Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
  • Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
  • Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.


Transaction Support

  • Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
  • Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
  • Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.


Qualifications:

  • University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
  • Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
  • Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
  • Willing to be responsive and communicative.
  • Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST.
  • The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
  • Good attitude necessary.

title: Estagiário de finanças
description:
A Otto é a primeira Fintech Boutique do Brasil , que combina finanças corporativas, tecnologia e inteligência para transformar a forma como empresas tomam decisão.

Não operamos como uma consultoria tradicional.

Somos um parceiro estratégico que atua dentro do negócio — estruturando dados, melhorando decisões e gerando impacto direto em caixa, lucro e valor.

Sem gravata. Sem frescura. Sem improviso.



O desafio

Buscamos um estagiário que não quer apenas “aprender finanças”.

Queremos alguém que:

  • pensa como construtor
  • tem interesse real por tecnologia e IA
  • quer entender como dados viram decisão

Aqui, finanças não são planilhas isoladas — são sistemas, modelos, automações e inteligência aplicada.


O que você vai fazer

  • Construir e evoluir modelos financeiros (DRE, fluxo de caixa, cenários)
  • Apoiar análises estratégicas para clientes reais
  • Trabalhar com estruturação de dados financeiros

Apoiar desenvolvimento de:

  • dashboards
  • automações
  • aplicações com IA para finanças
  • Participar de projetos como:
  • Planejamento Financeiro
  • Tesouraria
  • Controladoria
  • Turnaround e decisões críticas


O que esperamos

  • Excel avançado (não negociável)
  • Raciocínio lógico forte
  • Interesse genuíno por tecnologia, dados e IA
  • Capacidade de aprender rápido e executar


Diferenciais relevantes:

  • Power BI ou ferramentas de visualização
  • Noções de Python / automação / low-code
  • Uso prático avançado de IA (LLMs, agentes, automações, etc.)


O ambiente

  • Alta exigência e alta autonomia
  • Sócios seniores envolvidos nos projetos
  • Exposição real a decisões estratégicas
  • Espaço para construir (não só executar)


Para quem é essa vaga

  • Quer aprender finanças no nível que realmente importa
  • Gosta de tecnologia e quer aplicar isso no mundo real
  • Se incomoda com mediocridade e lentidão
  • Prefere desafio e crescimento acelerado

title: Operations Director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director


Introduction:

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.


This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.


Compensation:

  • $40,000-90,000 USD per year.


Duties & Responsibilities:


Permitting

  • Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
  • Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
  • Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
  • Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
  • Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.


Development Support

  • Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
  • File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.


Procurement

  • Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
  • Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
  • Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.


Transaction Support

  • Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
  • Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
  • Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.


Qualifications:

  • University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
  • Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
  • Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
  • Willing to be responsive and communicative.
  • Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST.
  • The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
  • Good attitude necessary.

title: Desenvolvimento ServiceNow Sênior
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com ServiceNow.



Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas utilizando ServiceNow App Engine
  • Criação e customização de portais (front-end) no ServiceNow
  • Desenvolvimento com tecnologias modernas como:
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Angular / React
  • Definição e evolução da arquitetura de soluções, garantindo escalabilidade e performance
  • Atuação próxima com áreas de negócio para levantamento e entendimento de requisitos
  • Garantia de boas práticas (segurança, performance e usabilidade)
  • Implementação de integrações entre sistemas, utilizando:
  • APIs REST
  • SOAP
  • Recursos nativos do ServiceNow


Requisitos Técnicos


  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos com ServiceNow
  • Forte atuação com:
  • ServiceNow App Engine
  • Service Portal
  • Widgets
  • APIs REST
  • Integrações com sistemas externos
  • Sólida experiência em:
  • Arquitetura de soluções
  • Sistemas escaláveis e de alta performance
  • Experiência em front-end:
  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Frameworks como Angular ou React


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VempraGFT

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

title: Analista de Compras Pleno
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados do mundo nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com um dos portfólios mais amplos de seguros do mercado, comercializamos nossos produtos através do canal de vendas do banco Santander Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.


Na ZS nos preocupamos em manter um ambiente que contemple a diversidade. São oferecidas oportunidades iguais e todos os candidatos são considerados qualificados para as vagas, sem discriminação por motivos de deficiência, sexo ou orientação sexual, gravidez ou licença-maternidade, raça ou origem nacional ou étnica, idade, religião ou crença, identidade de gênero, estado civil, status de veterano protegido (se aplicável) ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei.


Hoje estamos procurando um Analista de Compras Pleno. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, aqui é o seu lugar!


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Responsável pela gestão estratégica de compras e contratações.
  • Conduzir processos estratégicos de sourcing, concorrências e negociações para as categorias sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Realizar análises de custos como TCO, Cost Breakdown;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de compras, desde a identificação da demanda até a formalização contratual e acompanhamento do fornecedor.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de categoria para Marketing, Clientes, Call Center, Jurídico, Financeiro e Consultorias.
  • Liderar RFPs, RFIs e RFQs, garantindo competitividade, transparência e melhores condições comerciais.

  • Familiaridade de processos de governança, compliance e controles internos.
  • Capacidade de atuação consultiva junto às áreas técnicas e de negócios (gerenciamento de stakeholders).

  • Capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Pernambuco
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CFP, CFA, CGA, C-PRO R, C-PRO I ou CPA-20 (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Dados - Python
description:
Sobre a empresa


Como empresa líder em tecnologia somos um universo de pessoas inconformadas, movidas por inovação, autonomia, aprendizado e performance. Juntos e juntas, criamos oportunidades, transformamos futuros e compartilhamos conhecimento. Aqui o seu desenvolvimento profissional acontece em um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e energizante. De gente pra gente!


Buscamos o crescimento sustentável. E usamos dados e IA para impulsionar resultados mais inteligentes e eficientes para os nossos clientes.


Vem com a gente inovar e construir o futuro da tecnologia.


#VemPraTOTVS #SomosTOTVS


Descrição da vaga


Como Especialista em Engenharia de Dados você terá como missão principal projetar, construir e manter a infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável da área de Geração de Demanda. Será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados que garantam a coleta, integração, tratamento e disponibilização de dados que possam se tornar informações para insights, tomada de decisão e definição de acionáveis.


Seu foco estratégico será a criação e o enriquecimento de uma base de dados unificada sobre leads e clientes, incorporando dados das empresas, de suas personas decisoras ou influenciadores de compra, informações de contato e outros dados que possam alimentar lógicas e scores de propensão de compra, além de sustentar a gestão por indicadores de performance. Tudo isso visando capacitar análises avançadas e a tomada de decisões estratégicas de crescimento


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar estruturas de dados eficientes e escaláveis para sistemas de gestão de indicadores de performance;
  • Criar, manter e otimizar pipelines de ETL para integrar dados provenientes de diversas fontes internas e externas;
  • Arquitetar e construir um banco de dados centralizado e robusto para cadastro, enriquecimento e monitoramento contínuo de leads (prospects e clientes);
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade, segurança e governança dos dados em todo o ciclo de vida;
  • Implementar processos de validação e limpeza de dados para assegurar a confiabilidade das informações;
  • Preparar e disponibilizar conjuntos de dados limpos e estruturados para equipes de Business Intelligence e Gestão de Geração de Demanda, viabilizando análises avançadas, construção de modelos preditivos e relatórios de performance,
  • Avaliar e implementar ferramentas e tecnologias para a gestão, processamento e disponibilização de dados, incluindo aquelas que suportam soluções de Inteligência Artificial.


Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia;
  • Sólida vivência com processo de ETL e análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento e usabilidade em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Looker, Power BI, Tableau, entre outras);
  • Manipulação de dados em Python e SQL;
  • Vivência com as plataformas AWS, Azure ou GCP,
  • Experiência com ferramentas e frameworks de Big Data (Apache, Hadoop).


Requisitos desejáveis

SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:


  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de marketing ou CRMs (RD Station, Exact Sales, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce) como fontes de dados;
  • Vivência com dados voltados para Geração de Demandas, Marketing e/ ou Vendas;
  • Experiência com Data Governance e LGPD/GDPR,
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Dados/IA.


Modelo de Trabalho


  • Modelo Híbrido: Disponibilidade para atuar 3x presenciais na unidade matriz localizada em Santana, Zona Norte.


Benefícios


  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer
description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for a Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer to support analytics and tracking implementation across web, mobile (iOS/Android), and CTV/OTT platforms for a large-scale streaming product. This is a hands-on implementation and QA-focused role.


The engineer will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Analytics teams to ensure accurate data capture, validation, and measurement across digital platforms.


Key Responsibilities:

- Translate business and product requirements into clear tracking specifications

- Implement and validate analytics tracking across Web, iOS, Android, and CTV/OTT platforms

- Perform data validation, QA checks, and event verification

- Troubleshoot tracking issues and data discrepancies

- Validate third-party measurement tools such as Nielsen and comScore

- Maintain tracking documentation and support release readiness


Required Skills & Experience:

- Strong experience with digital analytics tracking implementation

- Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics

- Experience with Tealium or similar tag management tools (Adobe Launch, GTM, etc.)

- Strong background in analytics QA, validation, and debugging

- Experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


Platforms:

- Web applications

- Mobile apps (iOS & Android)

- OTT / CTV platforms

- Streaming / digital media products

title: Agentic Developer
description:

O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.


O seu papel como Software Engineering Backend:

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.

title: Agentic Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain critical systems and services across the client's platform
  • Develop scalable, secure, multi-tenant features and services used by customers and internal teams
  • Build and maintain backend APIs and service-to-service integrations
  • Contribute to modern web applications using Angular or comparable frontend frameworks
  • Improve system reliability, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help modernize legacy components while preserving stability in a live SaaS platform
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering patterns
  • Write and maintain automated tests
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving
  • Mentor engineers and help raise technical standards across the team
  • Participate in incident response and operational improvement as needed
  • AI / Agentic Responsibilities:
  • Use AI agents and LLM-based tools as a core part of daily development workflows
  • Apply agents to support:

Requirements clarification

System design

Code generation and refactoring

Debugging and root cause analysis

Test creation and validation

Code review and quality improvement

Critically evaluate, challenge, and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure production-grade quality

Contribute to evolving best practices for agent-assisted development within the team


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining SaaS platforms
  • Experience building modern web applications using Angular, React.js, or similar frameworks
  • Experience designing and supporting APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, service-oriented architecture, or event-driven systems
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, including unit and integration tests
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Experience using agents to support requirements clarification, solution design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, code review, and test creation
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience applying test-driven development (TDD), test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design, including messaging, event flows, and distributed system behavior
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail, including reviewing and improving agent-assisted output
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls
  • AI / Agentic
  • Proven hands-on experience using AI agents, orchestration tools, or structured LLM workflows in real development environments
  • Experience using agents to support:

Requirements clarification

Solution design

Code generation

Refactoring

Debugging

Code review

Test creation

  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience working with tools or frameworks such as: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar

custom-built agent workflows

  • Strong understanding of limitations, failure modes, and trade-offs of LLM-based systems


Preferred Experience

  • Experience modernizing or untangling legacy web platforms
  • Experience with multi-tenant systems
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, observability tooling, and operational support in distributed systems
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments
  • Experience improving performance, stability, and operational maturity in customer-facing SaaS platforms
  • Experience applying TDD, test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together.
  • Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions.
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment.
  • Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer
description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for a Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer to support analytics and tracking implementation across web, mobile (iOS/Android), and CTV/OTT platforms for a large-scale streaming product. This is a hands-on implementation and QA-focused role.


The engineer will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Analytics teams to ensure accurate data capture, validation, and measurement across digital platforms.


Key Responsibilities:

- Translate business and product requirements into clear tracking specifications

- Implement and validate analytics tracking across Web, iOS, Android, and CTV/OTT platforms

- Perform data validation, QA checks, and event verification

- Troubleshoot tracking issues and data discrepancies

- Validate third-party measurement tools such as Nielsen and comScore

- Maintain tracking documentation and support release readiness


Required Skills & Experience:

- Strong experience with digital analytics tracking implementation

- Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics

- Experience with Tealium or similar tag management tools (Adobe Launch, GTM, etc.)

- Strong background in analytics QA, validation, and debugging

- Experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


Platforms:

- Web applications

- Mobile apps (iOS & Android)

- OTT / CTV platforms

- Streaming / digital media products

title: [Tech] Engenharia DevOps Sênior
description:
O especialista DevOps irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, e cresce a cada dia, ampliando continuamente seu potencial de impacto e inovação.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Orientar no processo de administração de dados e ambientes, através da execução de rotinas e ferramentas envolvidas na área, estipulando os prazos e prioridades da equipe.
  • Realizar atividade de triagem dos tickets abertos pelos clientes internos através da classificação ou categorização dos mesmos quando necessário, por tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento.
  • Promover ações de melhoria através da participação ativa das cerimônias do Ágil (Daily, reabastecimento, reviews e retrospectivas)
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/meta da área através da execução de suas atividades propostas
  • Identificar problemas de ambientes DevOps, integração contínua, e banco de dados implementando e inovando em soluções.
  • Estimular a equipe em processos de melhoria, usando seu conhecimento e experiência para identificar problemas e desenvolver soluções.
  • Garantir a sustentabilidade dos ambientes através da orientação dos demais integrantes do time no uso de boas práticas de DevOps.
  • Ser uma referência interna e externa em práticas DevOps, garantindo a sustentabilidade dos ambientes por meio da disseminação de conhecimento e participação de fóruns.
  • Realizar pesquisa e avaliação de novas tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de mercado, com o objetivo de identificar e propor soluções que aprimorem a eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade dos ambientes e processos de desenvolvimento, integração e operação.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Metodologia Ágil – nível domínio;
  • Kubernetes – nível avançado;
  • Cloud Pública (AWS, Azure, GCP) – nível intermediário;
  • Azure DevOps – nível intermediário;
  • Linux, containers e ferramentas de automação – nível avançado;
  • CI/CD – nível avançado;
  • Arquitetura Cloud Native – nível intermediário.


Certificação:

  • CKA Certified Kubernetes Administrator – desejável;
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner – desejável;
  • AWS Sysops Administrator – desejável;

title: Agentic Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

description:

- Web applications

- OTT / CTV platforms

title: Agentic Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.

title: Engenheiro (a) de IA (DevEx) Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga

Cargo: Engenheiro (a) de IA (DevEx) Sênior

Localização: São Paulo/SP

Data de publicação: 20/03/26



Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Definir, projetar e desenvolver agentes de IA integrados ao ecossistema de engenharia (repositórios, CI/CD, ferramentas de gestão, observabilidade e documentação);
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software em todo o ciclo de vida das soluções de IA: design, testes, segurança, observabilidade e performance;
  • Experimentar e implementar soluções com LLMs (prompts, RAG, orquestração de agentes), avaliando impacto e qualidade para o desenvolvedor;
  • Colaborar com outros times (arquitetura, segurança, produto e desenvolvimento) na definição de padrões, guidelines e uso responsável de IA;
  • Atuar como multiplicador, apoiando squads a utilizar e estender os agentes de IA, com documentação e compartilhamento de conhecimento.


Responsabilidades da área

A área é responsável por conduzir processos seletivos alinhados aos valores e à cultura da B3, garantindo uma experiência positiva para os candidatos. Além disso, colaboramos com os gestores para identificar necessidades específicas de recrutamento e propor soluções assertivas.


O que esperamos da sua atuação

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de software (nível sênior), atuando em backend ou full stack;
  • Domínio de pelo menos uma linguagem moderna de backend (por exemplo, Python, Java, C#, Node.js);
  • Experiência com APIs REST, serviços distribuídos e práticas de DevOps/DevEx (CI/CD, automação, observabilidade);
  • Vivência prática com IA generativa ou LLMs (uso de APIs de modelos, chatbots, assistentes, RAG ou similar);
  • Foco em experiência do desenvolvedor e ganho de produtividade;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com diferentes times;
  • Autonomia, senso de dono e capacidade de conduzir iniciativas de ponta a ponta;
  • Abertura à experimentação, aprendizado contínuo e uso responsável de IA;
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de engenharia: testes automatizados, revisão de código, design de sistemas e documentação técnica.

title: Agentic Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain critical systems and services across the client's platform
  • Develop scalable, secure, multi-tenant features and services used by customers and internal teams
  • Build and maintain backend APIs and service-to-service integrations
  • Contribute to modern web applications using Angular or comparable frontend frameworks
  • Improve system reliability, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help modernize legacy components while preserving stability in a live SaaS platform
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering patterns
  • Write and maintain automated tests
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving
  • Mentor engineers and help raise technical standards across the team
  • Participate in incident response and operational improvement as needed
  • AI / Agentic Responsibilities:
  • Use AI agents and LLM-based tools as a core part of daily development workflows
  • Apply agents to support:

Requirements clarification

System design

Code generation and refactoring

Debugging and root cause analysis

Test creation and validation

Code review and quality improvement

Critically evaluate, challenge, and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure production-grade quality

Contribute to evolving best practices for agent-assisted development within the team


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining SaaS platforms
  • Experience building modern web applications using Angular, React.js, or similar frameworks
  • Experience designing and supporting APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, service-oriented architecture, or event-driven systems
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, including unit and integration tests
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Experience using agents to support requirements clarification, solution design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, code review, and test creation
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience applying test-driven development (TDD), test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design, including messaging, event flows, and distributed system behavior
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail, including reviewing and improving agent-assisted output
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls
  • AI / Agentic
  • Proven hands-on experience using AI agents, orchestration tools, or structured LLM workflows in real development environments
  • Experience using agents to support:

Requirements clarification

Solution design

Code generation

Refactoring

Debugging

Code review

Test creation

  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience working with tools or frameworks such as: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar

title: [Tech] Engenharia DevOps Sênior
description:
O especialista DevOps irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, e cresce a cada dia, ampliando continuamente seu potencial de impacto e inovação.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Orientar no processo de administração de dados e ambientes, através da execução de rotinas e ferramentas envolvidas na área, estipulando os prazos e prioridades da equipe.
  • Realizar atividade de triagem dos tickets abertos pelos clientes internos através da classificação ou categorização dos mesmos quando necessário, por tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento.
  • Promover ações de melhoria através da participação ativa das cerimônias do Ágil (Daily, reabastecimento, reviews e retrospectivas)
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/meta da área através da execução de suas atividades propostas
  • Identificar problemas de ambientes DevOps, integração contínua, e banco de dados implementando e inovando em soluções.
  • Estimular a equipe em processos de melhoria, usando seu conhecimento e experiência para identificar problemas e desenvolver soluções.
  • Garantir a sustentabilidade dos ambientes através da orientação dos demais integrantes do time no uso de boas práticas de DevOps.
  • Ser uma referência interna e externa em práticas DevOps, garantindo a sustentabilidade dos ambientes por meio da disseminação de conhecimento e participação de fóruns.
  • Realizar pesquisa e avaliação de novas tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de mercado, com o objetivo de identificar e propor soluções que aprimorem a eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade dos ambientes e processos de desenvolvimento, integração e operação.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Metodologia Ágil – nível domínio;
  • Kubernetes – nível avançado;
  • Cloud Pública (AWS, Azure, GCP) – nível intermediário;
  • Azure DevOps – nível intermediário;
  • Linux, containers e ferramentas de automação – nível avançado;
  • CI/CD – nível avançado;
  • Arquitetura Cloud Native – nível intermediário.


Certificação:

  • CKA Certified Kubernetes Administrator – desejável;
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner – desejável;
  • AWS Sysops Administrator – desejável;

title: Agentic Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain critical systems and services across the client's platform
  • Develop scalable, secure, multi-tenant features and services used by customers and internal teams
  • Build and maintain backend APIs and service-to-service integrations
  • Contribute to modern web applications using Angular or comparable frontend frameworks
  • Improve system reliability, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help modernize legacy components while preserving stability in a live SaaS platform
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering patterns
  • Write and maintain automated tests
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving
  • Mentor engineers and help raise technical standards across the team
  • Participate in incident response and operational improvement as needed
  • AI / Agentic Responsibilities:
  • Use AI agents and LLM-based tools as a core part of daily development workflows
  • Apply agents to support:

Requirements clarification

System design

Code generation and refactoring

Debugging and root cause analysis

Test creation and validation

Code review and quality improvement

Critically evaluate, challenge, and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure production-grade quality

Contribute to evolving best practices for agent-assisted development within the team


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining SaaS platforms
  • Experience building modern web applications using Angular, React.js, or similar frameworks
  • Experience designing and supporting APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, service-oriented architecture, or event-driven systems
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, including unit and integration tests
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Experience using agents to support requirements clarification, solution design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, code review, and test creation
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience applying test-driven development (TDD), test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design, including messaging, event flows, and distributed system behavior
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail, including reviewing and improving agent-assisted output
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls
  • AI / Agentic
  • Proven hands-on experience using AI agents, orchestration tools, or structured LLM workflows in real development environments
  • Experience using agents to support:

Requirements clarification

Solution design

Code generation

Refactoring

Debugging

Code review

Test creation

  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience working with tools or frameworks such as: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar

custom-built agent workflows

  • Strong understanding of limitations, failure modes, and trade-offs of LLM-based systems


Preferred Experience

  • Experience modernizing or untangling legacy web platforms
  • Experience with multi-tenant systems
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, observability tooling, and operational support in distributed systems
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments
  • Experience improving performance, stability, and operational maturity in customer-facing SaaS platforms
  • Experience applying TDD, test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together.
  • Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions.
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment.
  • Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer
description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for a Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer to support analytics and tracking implementation across web, mobile (iOS/Android), and CTV/OTT platforms for a large-scale streaming product. This is a hands-on implementation and QA-focused role.


The engineer will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Analytics teams to ensure accurate data capture, validation, and measurement across digital platforms.


Key Responsibilities:

- Translate business and product requirements into clear tracking specifications

- Implement and validate analytics tracking across Web, iOS, Android, and CTV/OTT platforms

- Perform data validation, QA checks, and event verification

- Troubleshoot tracking issues and data discrepancies

- Validate third-party measurement tools such as Nielsen and comScore

- Maintain tracking documentation and support release readiness


Required Skills & Experience:

- Strong experience with digital analytics tracking implementation

- Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics

- Experience with Tealium or similar tag management tools (Adobe Launch, GTM, etc.)

- Strong background in analytics QA, validation, and debugging

- Experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


Platforms:

- Web applications

- Mobile apps (iOS & Android)

- OTT / CTV platforms

- Streaming / digital media products

title: Agentic Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain critical systems and services across the client's platform
  • Develop scalable, secure, multi-tenant features and services used by customers and internal teams
  • Build and maintain backend APIs and service-to-service integrations
  • Contribute to modern web applications using Angular or comparable frontend frameworks
  • Improve system reliability, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help modernize legacy components while preserving stability in a live SaaS platform
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering patterns
  • Write and maintain automated tests
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving
  • Mentor engineers and help raise technical standards across the team
  • Participate in incident response and operational improvement as needed
  • AI / Agentic Responsibilities:
  • Use AI agents and LLM-based tools as a core part of daily development workflows
  • Apply agents to support:

Requirements clarification

System design

Code generation and refactoring

Debugging and root cause analysis

Test creation and validation

Code review and quality improvement

Critically evaluate, challenge, and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure production-grade quality

Contribute to evolving best practices for agent-assisted development within the team


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining SaaS platforms
  • Experience building modern web applications using Angular, React.js, or similar frameworks
  • Experience designing and supporting APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, service-oriented architecture, or event-driven systems
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, including unit and integration tests
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Experience using agents to support requirements clarification, solution design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, code review, and test creation
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience applying test-driven development (TDD), test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design, including messaging, event flows, and distributed system behavior
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail, including reviewing and improving agent-assisted output
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls
  • AI / Agentic
  • Proven hands-on experience using AI agents, orchestration tools, or structured LLM workflows in real development environments
  • Experience using agents to support:

Requirements clarification

Solution design

Code generation

Refactoring

Debugging

Code review

Test creation

  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience working with tools or frameworks such as: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar

custom-built agent workflows

  • Strong understanding of limitations, failure modes, and trade-offs of LLM-based systems


Preferred Experience

  • Experience modernizing or untangling legacy web platforms
  • Experience with multi-tenant systems
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, observability tooling, and operational support in distributed systems
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments
  • Experience improving performance, stability, and operational maturity in customer-facing SaaS platforms
  • Experience applying TDD, test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together.
  • Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions.
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment.
  • Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for a Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer to support analytics and tracking implementation across web, mobile (iOS/Android), and CTV/OTT platforms for a large-scale streaming product. This is a hands-on implementation and QA-focused role.

title: Agentic Developer
description:

In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. custom-built agent workflows

title: Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer
description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for a Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer to support analytics and tracking implementation across web, mobile (iOS/Android), and CTV/OTT platforms for a large-scale streaming product. This is a hands-on implementation and QA-focused role.


The engineer will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Analytics teams to ensure accurate data capture, validation, and measurement across digital platforms.


Key Responsibilities:

- Translate business and product requirements into clear tracking specifications

- Implement and validate analytics tracking across Web, iOS, Android, and CTV/OTT platforms

- Perform data validation, QA checks, and event verification

- Troubleshoot tracking issues and data discrepancies

- Validate third-party measurement tools such as Nielsen and comScore

- Maintain tracking documentation and support release readiness


Required Skills & Experience:

- Strong experience with digital analytics tracking implementation

- Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics

- Experience with Tealium or similar tag management tools (Adobe Launch, GTM, etc.)

- Strong background in analytics QA, validation, and debugging

- Experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


Platforms:

- Web applications

- Mobile apps (iOS & Android)

- OTT / CTV platforms

- Streaming / digital media products

title: [Tech] Engenharia DevOps Sênior
description:
O especialista DevOps irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, e cresce a cada dia, ampliando continuamente seu potencial de impacto e inovação.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Orientar no processo de administração de dados e ambientes, através da execução de rotinas e ferramentas envolvidas na área, estipulando os prazos e prioridades da equipe.
  • Realizar atividade de triagem dos tickets abertos pelos clientes internos através da classificação ou categorização dos mesmos quando necessário, por tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento.
  • Promover ações de melhoria através da participação ativa das cerimônias do Ágil (Daily, reabastecimento, reviews e retrospectivas)
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/meta da área através da execução de suas atividades propostas
  • Identificar problemas de ambientes DevOps, integração contínua, e banco de dados implementando e inovando em soluções.
  • Estimular a equipe em processos de melhoria, usando seu conhecimento e experiência para identificar problemas e desenvolver soluções.
  • Garantir a sustentabilidade dos ambientes através da orientação dos demais integrantes do time no uso de boas práticas de DevOps.
  • Ser uma referência interna e externa em práticas DevOps, garantindo a sustentabilidade dos ambientes por meio da disseminação de conhecimento e participação de fóruns.
  • Realizar pesquisa e avaliação de novas tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de mercado, com o objetivo de identificar e propor soluções que aprimorem a eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade dos ambientes e processos de desenvolvimento, integração e operação.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Metodologia Ágil – nível domínio;
  • Kubernetes – nível avançado;
  • Cloud Pública (AWS, Azure, GCP) – nível intermediário;
  • Azure DevOps – nível intermediário;
  • Linux, containers e ferramentas de automação – nível avançado;
  • CI/CD – nível avançado;
  • Arquitetura Cloud Native – nível intermediário.


Certificação:

  • CKA Certified Kubernetes Administrator – desejável;
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner – desejável;
  • AWS Sysops Administrator – desejável;
